invariants: Private-constructible concrete Version capability. No public callback, arbitrary owner trait, descriptor, raw token or owner getter.
Selection is the original evaluated four-cut purpose. NextUse is the original same-C five-cut purpose fixed by actual opaque S.
Public export requires actual Published, same original owners, original full current before and after, and original signature/context verification.
Every read uses concrete Version current checks before and after actual C/Selection response. Shared original T/E channels remain in Version.
One local capability owns one original Version semaphore permit. Clone and readiness share one Arc, one request counter, one retained-result state and one terminal slot.
Original four Version permits, 128 requests, per-call timeout at most 500 ms, lifetime at most 300 s and immutable Version absolute end are retained.

Cancellation/error/timeout leaves the shared slot empty. A late blocking read cannot restore the slot or deliver success after its deadline; no rollback of already-dispatched original owner I/O is claimed.
Ready becoming Pending or a retained original read changing is rejected across aliases and across readiness/readback.
Original remote/by-value APIs and original legacy purpose rejection are retained.
version_capacity: Root Version + FinalUse + local Selection + local NextUse = at most four held permits; readiness borrows the same NextUse capability and does not acquire another permit.
